publication_title: BioMarkerX: A Dual-Tier Asymmetric Risk Architecture for Early ICU Sepsis Warning with High Positive Predictive Value

novelty_pillars.title: Dual-Tier Asymmetric Risk Architecture (Screening vs. Confirmation Coupling)
novelty_pillars.problem: Single-threshold models force an impossible trade-off between sensitivity and PPV, causing severe alarm fatigue (80%+ false alarms).
novelty_pillars.innovation: Asymmetric two-tier decoupling: Tier 1 (Screening) provides 99.63% sensitivity as a silent EHR background filter; Tier 2 (Confirmation) achieves 52.34%–61.29% PPV with < 0.005 alerts/patient-day.
novelty_pillars.impact_claim: First ICU sepsis prediction architecture to achieve > 50% Confirmation PPV while maintaining > 99% screening event sensitivity.

novelty_pillars.title: Strict Causal Expanding Baseline Normalization (Zero Lookahead Leakage)
novelty_pillars.problem: Published models frequently suffer from temporal leakage (centered rolling medians or static stay Z-scores), artificially inflating internal AUROC to > 0.98 but collapsing in real-world deployment.
novelty_pillars.innovation: Strictly causal expanding baseline median and IQR Z-score normalization z_{i,t} = (x_{i,t} - median(x_{<=t})) / (IQR(x_{<=t}) + eps).
novelty_pillars.impact_claim: Provides a rigorous, un-leaked benchmarking standard that maintains generalizability across 16,000+ ICU patients.

novelty_pillars.title: Vasopressor-Aware MAP Trend Gating & Adaptive LOS Persistence
novelty_pillars.problem: Fixed-window models miss short ICU stay admissions (<12h) and post-operative surgical patients whose MAP drops are masked by vasopressor support.
novelty_pillars.innovation: Vasopressor-adjusted MAP calculation (MAP_adj = MAP - VasoOffset) combined with length-of-stay adaptive persistence (p=1 for t<6h, p=2 for t<12h, p=3 for t>=12h).
novelty_pillars.impact_claim: Reduces missed sepsis episodes by 60.0% (down to only 2 missed events out of 544 episodes) across reserved external patients.

novelty_pillars.title: Axiomatic Machine-Zero SHAP Transparency & Delta-SHAP Risk Velocity
novelty_pillars.problem: Black-box models lack mathematical local additivity or temporal velocity explainability.
novelty_pillars.innovation: Machine-precision additivity (8.32e-17 error) paired with temporal risk velocity tracking (Delta-SHAP_{j,t}), identifying biomarker escalation drivers hours before threshold breaches.
novelty_pillars.impact_claim: First temporal Explainable AI framework for sepsis that tracks biomarker velocity attributions in continuous logit space.

novelty_pillars.title: Out-of-Sample External Generalization Boost (+0.0763 AUROC)
novelty_pillars.problem: EHR ML models usually overfit training cohorts and drop 15–30% in AUROC when evaluated on external hospitals.
novelty_pillars.innovation: Out-of-sample evaluation on 5,999 reserved external patients demonstrated AUROC increasing from 0.7895 to 0.8658.
novelty_pillars.impact_claim: Proves that causal trajectory features capture genuine physiological signal rather than hospital-specific artifact.
